answer: An AI-agent market admits handles such as gale, wharf and mesa through one on-chain registry. Its contract burns k settlement tokens before activating identity k; the counter never decreases. A farm with n registered identities pays at least n+1 tokens to register another, making n identities cost at least n(n+1)/2. Splitting wallets cannot split the global counter, deletion cannot rewind it, and pre-aging aliases in parallel still requires every burn at creation.
